superseded.text: **This file and `PROFILE.md` are the complete operating manual** - everything needed to run the wiki is in them. The pattern originates from Andrej Karpathy's llm-wiki idea, kept verbatim in [llm-wiki.md](llm-wiki.md) as background reading only: it is not part of the wiki, is never ingested, and wherever it differs from this file, this file wins.

semantic_changes.change: Task-routed normative modules replace all-in-one loading; universal scope/secrets/privacy protections remain mandatory; template maintenance does not authorize bootstrap.
Use a prepared MathJax renderer for all formulas on affected pages; repository page checker is optional. Setup occurs once, not in ordinary note editing.
Privacy cross-reference points to AGENTS.md; substantive rule unchanged.
Initialize only on user request for a learner wiki; add portable work lifecycle, preserving authorization scope.
